match.userMessage: One greyscale storyboard frame. Frozen in this action: MAYA bumps the kitchen door open with her hip as she calls out the order. Framing: medium wide, eye level, Handheld observational framing; MAYA held slightly off-center, three plates visible along her arm, kitchen door in the near background. Placement only, not the pose: MAYA stands beside the kitchen door, balancing three plates along her arm, focused on keeping them steady. Camera, as one or two arrows: handheld drift, then follow her through the doorway, immediate, gently unsteady. Characters: MAYA, Female, 30s, A woman in her 30s of unspecified nationality, Grey short-sleeved T-shirt, red waist apron, dark work. The bodies are frozen in that action: if someone sits, they are seated; if someone reaches, the arm is extended. One figure per character. Drawn as a storyboard artist's animatic frame: confident pencil line with flat grey marker tones, three or four values, greyscale only even where the description names a colour. Clear silhouettes, the set blocked in with simple shapes. Camera travel is one or two arrows. A rough pre-production drawing: not a finished illustration, not a photo, not a 3D render. The drawing fills the whole image edge to edge: no border, no frame line, no paper margin, no grid of panels. No text, no titles, no subtitles, no watermarks, no letters, no words, no signs, no UI elements.
